REPORT
File No. SPECIAL POLICE REGISTRY 8172
Date March 26, 1938.
Subject War Affected Areas Refugees Migration Society - Refunding of money to lottery ticket holders.
Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford D.I

With reference to the report on the Refugees Migration Society submitted on March 18 regarding the refunding of money subscribed to the lottery that was prohibited, observation shows that the refunding took place between March 19 and 21 at the office of the society at 101 Mandalay Road and that the period was extended to March 24. Attached herewith is a statement of accounts, which was obtained on March 25, from the society in connection with the prohibited lottery.

On March 23, the society was in receipt of a telegram from the Kiangsi Provincial Government informing them that they had received $1,500 from the Chinese Women's War Disaster Relief Association at Hongkong and $1,500 from the Chinese Women's Consolation Association, Hongkong Branch, as contributions towards the refugee migration scheme. In answer to this telegram, the Society requested the Kiangsi Provincial Government to retain the money as they intended sending a second batch of refugees to Kiangsi. It is learned that the society is making arrangements for the despatch of a second batch of 400 refugees from Shanghai to Kiangsi on or about April 10.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE FILE 28 MAR 1938 RECEIVED SECRETARIAT）

事由：战区难民迁移社——向彩票持有者退款。
呈报人：副督察高延根（Kao Yen-ken） 转呈人：C. Crawford 督察

关于3月18日提交的有关难民迁移社就禁止发行的彩票所募款项进行退款的报告，经查，退款事宜于3月19日至21日在该社位于曼达雷路（Mandalay Road）101号的办事处进行，且期限延长至3月24日。随函附上该社于3月25日提供的与禁止发行彩票有关的账目清单。

3月23日，该社收到江西省政府发来的电报，告知其已收到香港中国妇女战灾救济会捐款1,500元，以及香港中国妇女慰劳会分会捐款1,500元，作为难民迁移计划的资助。针对此电报，该社请求江西省政府保留这笔款项，因为他们打算向江西派遣第二批难民。据悉，该社正在安排于4月10日左右从上海向江西派遣第二批400名难民。

高延根
副督察

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处档案 1938年3月28日 秘书处收讫）

With reference to the decision which was reached
on March 10 by the War Affected Areas Refugees Migration
Society, 101 Mandalay Road, to refund the money to purchasers
of lottery tickets on March 16, further enquiries show that
the society has now postponed the refunding until March 19
and 21.

In the Hwa Mei Wan Pao Morning Edition dated March 18,
an advertisement appears under the name of the society, stating
that the holders of lottery tickets may have their money
returned at the office of the society, 101 Mandalay Road,

the society's funds, they should return their tickets to the
society with the names of the purchasers written thereon, so
that their names can be published in the press as donating
the money.

passed to the effect that any ticket holder wishing to attend

which was scheduled by the War Affected Areas Refugees Migration

now decided to refund the money to the purchasers of lottery
tickets under the following circumstances :-

1. Any purchaser wishing the return of his money should call
at the Dah Hwa (大華) Chartered Accountants' Office,
Room 239, 429 Kiukiang Road, on March 13, where his/her
name will be registered and the return of the money can
then be had at the office of the society on March 16.

money returned before March 16 through their friends.

performances in the Strand Theatre for three days and to
contribute the money earned towards refugee migration.

read the newspaper advertisements within the coming week

Subject Press Article reporting the opening of a bazaar of the
Refugees Migration Society on March 5 and 6.
Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford D. I

With reference to the article in the Shanghai
Daily News dated March 3, stating that the scheduled
bazaar of the Refugees Migration Society, which was prohibited
by the S.M.C., would be opened on March 5 and 6 in the
Pootung Guild Building, enquiries made at the Refugees
Migration Society, 101 Mandalay Road, show that the report
is groundless. It is learned that the society is to
petition the S.M.C. and the S.M.P. further, for permission
to hold the scheduled bazaar, lottery and concert, and
meanwhile is engaging Mr. Shen Hsueh-chun (沈學鈞), a
chartered accountant, Room 239, 429 Kiukiang Road, to draw
up a statement of account. According to Mr. Chienli
Wong, the General Secretary, if the society again fails to
secure permission from the S.M.C., the society will be
prepared to refund all monies to the purchasers of the
lottery tickets and will publish the date of refunding on
or about March 6. It is estimated that the society
sold a total of 1,878 lottery tickets in February at $1.00
each.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

Shanghai Daily News (上海日報), a mosquito paper :-

TEMPORARY BAZAAR OF REFUGEES' COLONIZATION COMMITTEE TO
BE OPENED ON MARCH 5 AND 6

In order to raise funds to finance the
colonization of refugees, the War Area Refugees' Colonization
Committee some time ago requested Chinese native products
factories to contribute products. It was also arranged
to open a temporary bazaar on February 26 and 27 at the
Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association on Yu Ya Ching Road.
Admission fees would be contributed toward the colonization
fund. The bazaar, however, could not be opened on the dates
specified due to action on the part of the S.M.C.
The negotiations between the Colonization
Committee and the S.M.C. over the opening of the temporary
bazaar have been satisfactory and it is now decided to
open the bazaar on March 5 and 6. It is probable that
the bazaar will be held in the premises of the Footung
Fellow Countrymen's Association.

O.S.I. Kao

难民垦殖委员会临时义卖市场将于3月5日和6日开放

为筹集难民垦殖资金，战区难民垦殖委员会前几日请求中国国货工厂捐献产品。还安排在虞洽卿路宁波同乡会于2月26日和27日开设临时义卖市场。入场费将捐入垦殖基金。然而，由于工部局采取行动，义卖市场未能在指定日期开放。
垦殖委员会与工部局就开放临时义卖市场进行的谈判令人满意，现决定于3月5日和6日开放义卖市场。义卖市场很可能在浦东同乡会会所举行。

I beg to report that on receiving the instructions in the attached file at 12 noon 26-2-38 the undersigned accompanied by Inspector Liu immediately proceeded to the Ningpo Guild and informed Mr. Liu Che Ying, a member of the Refugee Committee that the S.M. February 27, 1938. Morning Translation.

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:

THE REPATRIATION OF REFUGEES : CONCERT NOT HELD

With a view to raising funds for the repatriation
of some 800 refugees to South Kiangsi where they will engage
in land cultivation, the War Area Refugees Colonization
Association made preparations to inaugurate a temporary
emporium and to hold a concert in the Ningpo Fellow
Countrymen's Association building on February 26 and 27.
Unexpectedly, at 4 p.m. February 25 the Association
received a notice from the Shanghai Municipal Council
stating that the inauguration of the temporary emporium
as well as the holding of the concert could not be allowed.
The order was observed, and many people of all
walks of life who had arrived had to leave. Later the
Association posted up the following notice in the emporium:-
"The inauguration of this temporary emporium
and the holding of the concert, the preparations of which
had already been completed, would have been carried out
at the appointed time but for the fact that this Association
received a notice from the S.M.C. at 4 p.m. yesterday
(February 25) prohibiting same. Negotiations are being
opened over the matter. In the event of the negotiations
having no result, this Association will publish an
advertisement in local newspapers announcing the refund
of the sale of tickets."
Interviewed by our reporter, a spokesman of the
Association made the following statement:- "The holding
of a temporary emporium and the concert was for
charitable purposes. The action of the S.M.C. in
prohibiting them may be due to a misunderstanding.
Therefore, if the Association can secure permission for
these activities the date will be announced, but in case
the negotiations end in failure, then this Association
will abandon the project and refund the money to ticket
holders. Other ways and means to secure funds for the
repatriation of the refugees will be devised."

为筹集资金，以便将约800名难民遣返至赣南从事垦荒，战区难民移殖协会准备于2月26日和27日在宁波同乡会大楼开设临时商场并举行音乐会。不料，该协会于2月25日下午4时收到上海工部局通知，称不准开设临时商场及举行音乐会。该命令已获遵守，许多已到场的各界人士不得不离开。随后，该协会在商场张贴如下通告：
“本临时商场的开幕及音乐会的举行，各项准备工作虽已就绪，原定按时进行，但因本协会于昨日（2月25日）下午4时收到工部局禁止此项活动的通知，故未能如期举行。现正就此事宜进行交涉。若交涉无果，本协会将在本地报纸刊登广告，宣布退还售票款项。”
本报记者采访该协会发言人，其发表声明如下：“举办临时商场及音乐会系出于慈善目的。工部局予以禁止，或许是由于误解。因此，若本协会能获得开展这些活动的许可，将另行公布日期；但若交涉失败，本协会将放弃该计划，并向持票人退款。另将 devised 其他方法筹措难民遣返资金。”

12 FEB 1938

Inland Colonization Committee for
War Refugees, 101 Mandalay Road,
Shanghai, February 10th, 1938.

The Secretary,
S. M. C.,
Shanghai.

A charity Bazaar for the colonization of refugees, concerning.

Dear Sir,

As we have sent out the first group of refugees of
164 persons to Chisui hsien, Kiangsi, for colonization on 23rd
January, 1938, per S.S. Kwangtung via Hongkong, we are preparing
to send the second group of 450 refugees out in the first week
of March.

For raising funds to support the colonization of the
second group, we are preparing to hold a 2-day charity bazaar on
26th and 27th instant in the premise of Ningpo Guild, 460 Yu Ya
Ching Road, in the same way as the Christmas Bazaar held by
Y.M.C.A. last year in the building of Y.W.C.A., 999 Bubbling Well
Road.

The goods on sale in the bazaar are supplied by
various stores voluntarily and are parts of subscription. After
closing of the bazaar the unsold goods will be returned to their
owners respectively. Profits thus obtained are to be wholly
appropriated by this committee to refugee colonization purposes.

In order to facilitate good business of the bazaar,
ten thousand numbers of prizes are attached to the selling. The
value of each prize varies from 25 cents to 500 dollars. Each
$1 ticket or each buying of ten dollars of goods is entitled to
pick a concealed number of prize in which it contains one of
the above varieties.

The $1 ticket of totally 10,000 in number are sold
partly before hand and big stores are entrusted as agents with
5% commission given to them. Any participant of selling in this
bazaar managed by itself is charged with 20% of the amount sold.
We are aiming to obtain $5,000 from this bazaar to support the
colonization of our refugees.

A special committee of eleven is appointed for the
management of the bazaar and a regulation is drafted. A list
of names of the special committee, the regulation and a specimen
of the $1 ticket are herewith attached.

We beg to have your favourable sanction.

I am, Sir,
Yours faithfully,

C.L. Wang,
General Secretary.

Copy sent to S.M.P.

事由：关于为难民移殖举办慈善义卖。

尊敬的先生：

鉴于我们已于1938年1月23日通过经香港前往江西资溪县的“广东”轮（S.S. Kwangtung），送出首批164名难民进行移殖，我们正准备在三月的第一周送出第二批450名难民。

为筹集资金支持第二批难民的移殖，我们准备于本月26日及27日，在虞洽卿路460号宁波同乡会会所，举行为期两天的慈善义卖，方式类似于去年基督教青年会在静安寺路999号基督教女青年会大楼举办的圣诞义卖。

义卖商品由各家商店自愿提供，属于认捐性质。义卖结束后，未售出的商品将分别归还原主。由此获得的利润将全部由本委员会用于难民移殖事业。

为促进义卖生意兴隆，随销售附带一万张中奖号码。每件奖品价值从25美分到500美元不等。每张1美元的彩票或每购买10美元的商品，均有权抽取一个隐藏的中奖号码，其中包含上述各类奖品之一。

总计一万张的1美元彩票部分预先出售，并委托大商店作为代理，给予其5%的佣金。凡自行管理并在本次义卖中参与销售者，需缴纳销售额的20%作为费用。我们的目标是从此次义卖中获得5,000美元，以支持难民的移殖工作。

已任命一个由十一人组成的特别委员会负责管理义卖，并起草了规章。特此附上特别委员会名单、规章及1美元彩票样本。

恳请 阁下予以批准。

此致，

敬礼，

王慈良（C.L. Wang），
总干事。

Shanghai. February 10th, 1938.

The Special Branch,
S. M. P.
Shanghai.

A charity Bazaar for the colonization of refugees, concerning.

Dear Sir,
As we have sent out the first group of refugees of 164
persons to Chisui hsien, Kiangsi, for colonization on 23rd January
1938, per S.S. Kwangtung via Hongkong, we are preparing to send
the second group of 450 refugees out in the first week of March.

For rising funds to support the colonization of the second
group, we are preparing to hold a 2-day charity bazaar on 26th and
27th instant in the premise of Ningpo Guild, 480 Yu Ya Ching Road,
in the same way as the Christmas Bazaar held by Y.M.C.A. last year
in the building of Y.W.C.A., 999 Bubbling Well Road.

The goods on sale in the bazaar are supplied by various
stores voluntarily and are parts on subscription. After closing
of the bazaar the unsold goods will be returned to their owners
respectively. Profits thus obtained are to be wholly appropriated
by this committee to refugee colonization purposes.

In order to facilitate good business of the bazaar, ten
thousand numbers of prizes are attached to the selling. The value
of each prize varies from 25 cents to 500 dollars. Each $1 ticket
or each buying of ten dollars of goods is entitled to pick a con-
cealed number of prize in which it contains one of the above
varities.

The $1 ticket of totally 10,000 in number are sold partly
before hand and big stores are entrusted as agents with 5% commi-
ssion given to them. Any participant of selling in this bazaar
managed by itself is charged with 20% of the amount sold. We are
aiming to obtain $5,000 from this bazaar to support the coloniza-
tion of our refugees.

A special committee of eleven is appointed for the mana-
gement of the bazaar and a regulation is drafted. A list of names
of the special committee, the regulation and a specimen of the $1
ticket are herewith attached.

We beg to have your favorable sanction.

I am, Sir,

Yours faithfully,

Chienli Wang
General Secretary.

吾会已于1938年1月23日，经“广东”轮（S.S. Kwangtung）途经香港，将首批164名难民遣送至江西雩都县进行垦殖。现正筹备于3月第一周遣送第二批难民450人。

为筹集资金以支持第二批难民的垦殖工作，吾会拟于本月26日及27日，在虞洽卿路480号宁波同乡会会所，举行为期两天的慈善义卖。此次义卖形式参照去年基督教青年会（Y.M.C.A.）在南京西路99号基督教女青年会（Y.W.C.A.）大楼举办的圣诞义卖。

为促进义卖业务，随销售附设一万张奖券。奖品价值从25美分至500美元不等。每张1美元奖券或每购买10美元商品，即有权抽取一个隐藏号码，该号码对应上述各类奖品之一。

Subject War Affected Areas Refugees Migration Society -
Situation.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. Crawford

The War Affected Areas Refugees Migration Society,
101 Mandalay Road, has registered 540 refugee families up
to the present, consisting of 1,499 persons selected from
the local refugee camps, who are perfectly willing to proceed
inland to take up work on farms in Kiangse.

Sixty of the staff employees employed by the society
to assist in the transportation of these refugees to Kiangse
and to further the development scheme of migration, have
divided themselves into cliques, 20 of them banding them-
selves under one named Siao Chien-yung (蕭劍雄), living
at 238 Rue Pere Robert. This group is planning to promote
a "National Refugees Migration Society" on its own initiative.
On learning of this plan, Mr. Wong Chien-li (王千里),
the General Secretary, became annoyed and dismissed the
20 people responsible on the grounds of unsatisfactory work.

At 1 p.m. January 10, those twenty staff employees
assembled in the office of the society and demanded an
explanation from the General Secretary as to why he used the
grounds of unsatisfactory work to discharge them. At the
same time, they brought with them about 50 refugees who
stayed outside the office of the society, with the supposed
intention of creating trouble should the General Secretary
refuse to give a satisfactory reply in the matter. After
protracted negotiations, the General Secretary agreed to
withdraw his statement regarding the unsatisfactory work
and to make it known that those people resigned from the
society of their own accord. The dispute was thus amicably
settled.

战区难民迁移社（地址：曼达雷路101号）截至目前已登记540户难民家庭，共计1,499人，均选自本地难民营，他们完全愿意前往内地，在江西从事农场工作。

Date November 8, 1937.

Subject War Affected Areas' Refugees Migration Society -
Meeting.
Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by C. [Signature]

Six members of the Standing Committee of the
"War Affected Areas' Refugees Migration Society", 98 Foong Yu
Li, rue Chapsal, held a meeting in the Jen Chi Tang Benevolent
Society, 30 Yunnan Road, between 10 a.m. and 12.15 p.m.
November 6. Mr. Chuch Wen-Loh (屈文六), a member of the
Standing Committee of the Disaster Relief Federation of
Shanghai Benevolent Societies, presided. The following
resolutions were discussed and passed :-

1. That villages for local refugees be established at Kaoshun
and Liyang.

2. That arrangements be made with the Farmers' Bank of China
for a loan of $40,000 to finance the transporting of
refugees from Shanghai to those villages.

3. That the loan be repaid from the proceeds derived from
the sale of products from those villages.

4. That Mr. Wong Tsu-jing (王子華), a committee member of the
Industrial & Commercial Society, Room 324, Footun Build
Building, 1454 Avenue Edward VII, be appointed trustee for
the funds of the Society, under the supervision of the
Kiangsu Provincial Government.

5. That with effect from November 8, the Disaster Relief
Federation of Shanghai Benevolent Societies and the Shanghai
Branch of the Emergency Period Refugees Relief Committee
be requested to collect the names of 1,000 refugees, from
the camps, willing to proceed to those villages.

6. That the offices of the Society be removed on November 10
from the present address to 101 Landalay Road.
